verses.1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!
verses.2: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.3: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
verses.5: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
